mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher wage-driven consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing HOUST and RSAFS signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in robust demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO above its 6-month moving average indicates improving supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate productivity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 6mo MA, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in CPIAUCSL indicates decreasing inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate more accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in decreasing inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of decreasing UNRATE and increasing PAYEMS signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher wage-driven economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strengthening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 growth exceeds the previous quarter's growth, it signals accelerating economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth > prev quarter's growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
